clauses.quote: No Teacher shall be required to provide more detail than that which is required in the system-wide template.
Teachers shall not be required to submit daily, weekly, unit or long-range lesson plans on a regular basis.
the Supervisor may require the Teacher to submit daily lesson plans for review and comment until such time that the Teacher’s planning has satisfactorily improved.
In such cases, the Supervisor must suggest how the lesson plans can be improved.
they shall not be used in isolation to determine a Teacher’s effectiveness.
DCPS shall develop the lesson plan template in collaboration with the WTU.
The District of Columbia Public Schools shall maintain library and media center facilities.
clauses.subject_text: The District of Columbia Public Schools

clauses.quote: clerical assistance shall be provided for all Library Media Specialists.
Library Media Specialists shall not be assigned non-Library Media Specialist duties, which will cause the closing of the library.
the Library Media Specialist with building seniority shall be designated as team leader if the performance ratings are equal.
clauses.subject_text: the Library Media Specialist with building seniority

clauses.quote: Library Media Specialists shall be given the opportunity to acquire the necessary training for handling non print materials, provided funding is available.
the standards of the American Library Association shall be considered.
clauses.subject_text: the standards of the American Library Association

clauses.quote: Flexible scheduling for the use of the library shall be developed and implemented when it is deemed appropriate for the instructional program of the school by the Supervisor after consultation with the Library Media Specialist-media specialist.
clauses.subject_text: Flexible scheduling for the use of the library

clauses.quote: School Library Media Specialists shall arrange cooperative meetings and/or conferences with faculty Teachers during the employee’s workday.
